From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Exception request: Boarding & retention package for Priya Anand (Principal ModelOps)

Hi Marissa + Grace (cc Markus),

I need a quick decision on an out-of-band package for a high-priority Principal ModelOps candidate, Priya Anand (ref: HubSpot 00012876). Hiring timeline is tight — they have another in-flight offer and are asking for an updated equity refresh and an elevated one-time retention/boarding bonus. The recruiting partner flagged that we risk losing her unless we move beyond standard band.

Ask summary:
- Role: Principal ModelOps (Level: Senior IC / hiring manager: me)
- Standard band: Base $205k, Equity grant (RSU) 0.35% over 4 years, no sign-on cash by default
- Exception requested: 1) One-time boarding/retention bonus $50,000 (paid over 12 months), 2) Equity refresh to 0.55% (upfront grant + backstop clause), 3) One-time on-call premium $10,000 (recognizes holiday coverage).

Rationale:
- Priya has direct experience standing up our inferred runtime patterns and a background in LLM serving optimizations — hiring delay will materially delay a cross-team rollout with a key customer (Confidential Bank).
- The role will own a critical cross-region on-call cadence for Q1 — we need guaranteed coverage over holidays.
- Market comps show similar candidates receiving >0.5%+ in startups and high-performing infra teams.

I've attached the comp matrix and Priya's CV, and a short boarding plan that defines milestones tied to the retention payout. If we can approve the above exception, recruiting will route an updated offer today.

Please advise: can Marissa/Grace greenlight the package, or do you need a formal escalated packet? If approved, I suggest we tie 50% of the $50k bonus to 90-day acceptance milestones and 50% at 12 months.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Model Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the quick summary and attachments. A few quick clarifying Qs before I escalate:
1) Is the $50k bonus fully cash (no clawback)? You mentioned milestones — please confirm the exact vesting schedule.
2) How does the proposed 0.55% equity fit into our comp band ceilings for Principal? Is this a true uplift or a restructure of grant timing?
3) Any customer commitment (e.g., early access agreement) that justifies the premium?

If you can confirm the milestone schedule and that the equity is an upfront grant (not a time-based adjustment), I'm open to seeking exception approval from Total Rewards. Grace — tagging you because of the cross-team on-call implication.

-Marissa

> 1) Is the $50k bonus fully cash (no clawback)? You mentioned milestones — please confirm the exact vesting schedule.
> 2) How does the proposed 0.55% equity fit into our comp band ceilings for Principal? Is this a true uplift or a restructure of grant timing?
> 3) Any customer commitment (e.g., early access agreement) that justifies the premium?

Hi — answers inline: 
1) Bonus structure: 50% ($25k) paid at first payroll after 90 days (condition: active employee + 90-day performance check), 50% ($25k) paid at 12 months. In the boarding_plan_qa docx I included a short QA and a potential clawback if the employee leaves before 6 months (pro-rated). We can incorporate a standard clawback clause if Total Rewards requires it.
2) Equity: proposed 0.55% is an upfront RSU tranche (fully vested on standard 4yr schedule). This is an uplift relative to the standard band for Principal — the comp_matrix has benchmarked comparables showing median 0.45% for similar roles. We are requesting a one-time uplift to 0.55% as a hiring premium, not a restructuring of base grant schedule.
3) Customer linkage: Yes — the Confidential Bank pilot requires a November onboarding to hit their Q1 SLAs. Losing Priya would push the pilot by multiple sprints and jeopardize our initial commercial timeline. There's also an informal LOE commitment from the customer to prioritize Redwood integration if we can meet the Q1 timeline.

If you want, I can pull more formal customer notes into the packet, but hiring windows are small. Seeking your permission to route to Total Rewards + Finance for a final sign-off (I can prepare a 1-pager for the exception committee).

Karthik
Director, Model Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik — I reviewed the attachments and the rationale. Given the customer risk and the candidate's fit, I approve moving forward with the exception packet to Total Rewards and Finance with the following conditions:
- Add a 6-month pro-rated clawback on the $50k bonus (50% if departure before 6 months).
- Equity uplift to 0.55% as proposed, but request that we cap any future refresh in the first 18 months at 0.1% additional (guardrail).
- On-call premium of $10k approved as a one-time discretionary payment; include an explicit holiday schedule in the boarding plan.

Grace/Markus: if Finance/Legal need more from your side, please escalate. Karthik: please route the finalized packet today — recruiting should be ready to extend conditional offer once we have formal sign-off.

Thanks — Marissa
